newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Transport Dept chooses Johnson Controls.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Transport Dept chooses Johnson Controls.

text.p: Illinois Transportation Secretary Kirk Brown said Wednesday that a subsidiary of Johnson Controls Inc has been selected to operate Meigs Field if and when the state takes control of the regional airport.

Johnson Controls, Milwaukee, Wis.-based parent company of Johnson Controls Inc of Cape Canaveral, Fla., said it had been notified yesterday that the Florida unit was the winning bidder for the contract which covers temporary operation and management of Miegs.
The state is currently negotiating the terms and amount of the agreement, which covers six months beginning October 1, 1996 or the date the state takes over responsibility.

Johnson Controls' Integrated Facility Management division provides on site operations and maintenance of government and commercial facilities. It currently provides on-site staff and management for all of Ameritech Inc's facilities in its five state area which number 3,000 buildings. The division also operates and manages more than 25 million square feet of IBM Corp's facilities in North America and Europe.
